The Nasdaq Listing Rules requires listed companies to maintain stockholders' equity of at least $10 million. The Company's Form 6-K filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on February 16, 2023 reported stockholders’ equity of approximately $9.9 million as of September 30, 2022, which is below the minimum stockholders' equity required for continued listing pursuant to the Nasdaq Listing Rules.
